name: Collection Hero
summary: Passive collection introduction with a contextual heading, optional concise copy and count, and image-derived contrast presentation.

anatomy.name: image
anatomy.description: Optional real collection image whose presence derives image-backed presentation.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Generated semantic contrast layer when image media exists.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Centered readable content stack above optional media.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: One visible native collection heading at the surrounding document rank.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Text-only composition when no image is supplied.

variants.name: with-image
variants.description: Image-backed composition derived from image-slot presence, never selected independently.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Single intrinsic composition that fills its containing inline size.

states.name: textOnly
states.description: Archival-surface composition when no image exists.

states.name: withImage
states.description: Image-backed composition derived from supplied image media with theme-paired contrast.

behavior.name: contextualHeading
behavior.description: The target renders exactly one visible native title heading at the surrounding page rank; heading rank is not a decorative property.

behavior.name: collectionData
behavior.description: Adapters map collection identity and already localized count text while omitting absent optional nodes.

behavior.name: imageDerivedPresentation
behavior.description: Supplying image media derives the with-image class and contrast layer; consumers cannot select a contradictory independent variant.

behavior.name: imageSemantics
behavior.description: Informative images receive useful contextual alt text; decorative atmosphere preserves an empty alt attribute rather than copying the title.

behavior.name: passiveContent
behavior.description: The component owns no interaction, focus, motion, live-region, fetching, or controlled/uncontrolled lifecycle.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Visible collection identity rendered in one context-ranked native heading.

properties.name: count
properties.description: Optional already localized and target-formatted product count; not an implicit live region.

properties.name: image
properties.description: Optional real collection media whose presence makes the target derive image-backed presentation.

properties.name: imageAlt
properties.unsetBehavior: Use an empty alt attribute when supplied image media is decorative.
properties.description: Contextual image alternative when media is informative; empty string remains a valid decorative decision.

accessibility: Render exactly one visible native collection-title heading at the page-appropriate rank; do not expose heading rank as a decorative switch.
Give informative image media useful contextual alt text and preserve alt="" for decorative atmosphere; never inject the collection title merely to avoid an empty value.
Verify image-backed text contrast against every supplied frame in light and dark themes; forced colors must not depend on image pixels.
Expose optional count as localized readable text, not an implicit live region; filters or results own synchronized announcements.
Preserve passive semantics with no widget role, focus model, keyboard behavior, or reduced-motion requirement.

web.notes: Canonical CSS implements intrinsic layout, image-derived contrast, theme pairing, overflow safety, and forced-colors behavior without runtime.

shopify.notes: The collection-template section maps native collection data, merchant-visible optional parts, image alt semantics, localized count copy, and image-derived presentation.
